source: Yesterday morning they polished my plaque. “Great Nav’ed the Mesquite Tree.” In the afternoon a district official made a speech about this little space. My home. Called, henceforth, the “Savyna Praetis Tomb Garden.” The official said many niceties. A band with electrical horns and strummers played the city’s anthem. A vendor gave out bags of popped corn. Free of charge. What a place to witness. A nexus of evolution. Last century: starving, thirsting humans. Slaves of dust. Violent beyond necessity. Today: communities of mutual prosperity. Shared peace. I stand surprised. I stand corrected. Who could have imagined? Beings with a limitless capacity for cruelty have the same capacity for miracles. They have dulled their base instincts, their greed. Generation after generation of learned empathy. Their minds have left the cave behind. What is there to fear when you can count on your neighbor? They are all butterflies, broken free from the cocoon, tasting the sky.
target: 昨晨，他们擦亮我的牌子：「伟大的纳维德牧豆树」。午后，区官员为这小地方，我的家，演说。从此叫「莎维娜・普雷蒂斯陵园」。他说了许多好话，电喇叭与弦乐队奏城歌，摊贩送爆米花，免费。 多值得见证的地方。演变交会之地。 上个世纪，人类饥渴，尘土的奴隶，暴力远超需要。 今日，共同繁荣的社群，共享和平。 我站着惊叹，承认自己错了。谁能想像？残酷无限的生物，创造奇迹的能力也无限。他们磨钝原始本能与贪婪，一代代学会同理，心智走出洞穴。能依靠邻居，还有何可怕？ 他们都是蝴蝶，破茧而出，品尝天空。

source: Day 27 Sector 341 of Pine Forest North CONFIRMED FOUND IT! I RECREATED THE TEMPORAL EVENT! Months of searching, swinging my gem around, sector by sector, like some crazed fool in the pine forest. My advisors ceaselessly checking on me with guards. Watching me, following me with such regularity that I had to ask Vyndor Praetis, my clever cousin with that charming Pitra-Patra robot, to obtain a logger’s wagon for me to get into the forest undetected. Leave at dawn, return by noon. Day in and day out. Five months. And it actually exists. It is reality. It is truth! I’m glad I listened to you Uncle Eb! My Exomnus processor was sifting through recent archaeology logs entered into the Libraria database last night, filtering for discoveries in the pine forest. It hit a recent find: a buried stone slab with “Sadie Sloan” on it. Dated from the year 1897. The scholar noted this as “likely a joke.” Auntie Dee’s childhood grave? I wondered… Immediately I referenced my personal grid map of the pine forest and vanished into the woods at morning light. I left a note on my bed to my advisors. They can handle the day’s agenda. I found the digsite for the grave and I began slashing the air with my green gem. The sector was squared at 20x20 meters. Two hours into my swinging, I felt the pangs of doubt. I was hungry and thirsty, and I began questioning my sanity. But then it opened! With the flash of lightning, a tear in the ether, a laceration in existence, rippling with energy, like heat off of sun-charged concrete. I can’t recall how long I stared at this magnificent radiation. I grabbed a pine cone and tossed it in. The cut swallowed it whole and closed. Should I worry about the implications? Nothing seemed to change. I had to know if all this was replicable. I swung my gem excitedly. In no time I found the area, the exact place to swipe, and the rippling time-tear reappeared. I tossed a stick. Swallowed. Portal closed. I let out a guttural yell. A cathartic wail. It was all I could think to do, all I wanted to do in that moment of supreme validation. This is how Auntie Dee must have felt when she realized she was not crazy. The relief is nothing short of redemptive. Though I must have frightened someone. I heard footsteps scurry through the needles. Was it real? Paranoia? As I record this I’m still unsure…
target: 第 27 天 北松林第 341 区 确认 找到了！我重现了时间事件！ 几个月，像疯子在松林一区区搜索，挥舞宝石。顾问带守卫不断查看，监视、跟随，频繁得让我不得不请聪明的堂亲温多尔・普雷蒂斯，那个有迷人皮特拉・帕特拉机器人的家伙，弄辆伐木车，好悄悄进林。黎明走，中午回，日复一日，五个月。 它真存在，是现实，是真相！艾伯叔叔，幸好听了你的话！ 昨夜，艾克索姆语处理器筛查图书馆资料库新登录的考古纪录，锁定松林发现。找到一笔：出土石碑，刻「莎蒂・斯隆」，日期 1897 年。学者注记「可能是恶作剧」。蒂姨童年的坟？我想…… 立刻查自己的松林网格图，天亮就消失林间。床上留纸条给顾问，他们能处理今天行程。 找到墓碑挖掘处，我开始拿绿宝石划空。区域二十公尺见方。挥两小时，怀疑刺上心头，又饿又渴，开始质疑自己是否清醒。 然后，它开了！电光一闪，以太撕裂，存在划开伤口，能量波荡，如晒热混凝土上升起的热气。不记得盯着这壮丽光辐多久。我抓松果扔入，裂口整个吞下，关闭。 该担心后果吗？似乎没变。我得知道能否重现，兴奋挥宝石，很快找到精确位置，时间裂口再次波荡。 扔根木棍，吞下，门关。 我从喉底吼出，宣泄长嚎。如此确凿的证明之前，那是唯一能想、唯一想做的事。蒂姨发现自己没疯，必定也是如此。这份解脱，无异救赎。 不过，也许吓到了谁。我听见脚步匆匆穿过松针。真的？疑神疑鬼？记录此刻，仍不确定……

source:
A pinecone plops into a forest of Aspen. 

The air is damp and warm. Perfect conditions for germination.

The pinecone releases its seeds, which scatter in the wind.
target:
一颗松果，噗地落进白杨林。

空气温暖湿润，正适合发芽。

松果释出种子，随风四散。

source: Rrrm? Thud. Rustle. In the needles. East… *Sniff* Was this stick… strange smell. Sweet. Not like other stick… Rrm? More rustle. Pattern. Steps? Lower neck. Ear to earth. Northeast… Rrrrmmm, there! What a find, what a find... Tribe-girl from the village. Rreh, more bone than meat. But not forget – they take cave of shiny-black… Pounce. Spotted – CHASE! “RRRAAAASSssss!” Much slower than tribe-hunters. Simple snack. Trapped now she swing a green rock and— What? What this lightning she step in… GO! CAVE-TAKERS MUST DIE!
target: 呜嗯？ 咚，沙沙。松针里，东…… ＊嗅＊这木棍……怪味，甜。不像别的棍……呜嗯？ 更多沙沙，有规律。脚步？ 低颈，耳贴地。东北…… 呜噜，在那！好发现，好发现…… 村里部落女孩，骨比肉多。可不能忘，他们夺走亮黑洞…… 扑。被看见，追！ 「吼嘶——！」 比部落猎人慢多，简单点心。困住了，挥绿石，然后—— 什么？她走进这闪电……追！夺洞者必须死！

source: Gentle warmth. Damp air. Rich soil. My roots can stretch in all directions. A forest of my own design. Of the same root web. Next spring I’ll begin. Release new shoots. RRFFFFF?! A mega-elk rising on his haunches, posting his massive frame against me and reaching for my leaves. Its broad antlers clack against my trunk. I creak and bend from its weight. Were it not for these giant leaf-eaters, this place would be perfect.
target: 柔和暖意，湿润空气，肥沃土壤。 根能向四方伸展，设计自己的森林，共享根网。 明春开始，放出新芽。 呜哼？！ 巨鹿后腿站起，庞大身躯抵住我，伸向叶子。宽角敲击树干，我被重量压弯，吱嘎作响。 若不是这些巨型吃叶怪，这里就完美了。

source: Rrrrmmm. Brave man with black mane takes the cave of shiny-black. I want cave. Home I want but cannot have. His tribe grow fast. Grow strong. Make other tribe join into his. Make other tribe hunt and gather in bigger groups. rrrrrRRRMMM! Too many for me! Too many to kill! They take my grassland with field hen. Take my creek with giant beaver. And now they take shiny-black cave. Only grow more strong from it. Chip off shiny-black rock from wall, make rock sharp as my teeth. Can slice. Can cut. Can stab. Takers will die. Will watch. Will wait. Will kill. When one weak, I strike…
target: 呜噜噜。黑鬃勇士夺走亮黑洞。我想要洞，想要的家，却拿不到。 部落长很快，变强。叫别的部落加入，叫别人更大群狩猎采集。呜吼！太多！杀不完！ 夺走有野鸡的草地，有巨河狸的溪，现在夺亮黑洞。只会更强。从洞壁敲亮黑石，做得像我牙尖。能切，能割，能刺。 夺取者必死。 看，等，杀。一个变弱，我就击……

source: Yira Yem! Many fire-tails in the sky. The star-people shooting fire arrows again. Then was the big-loud…
target: 伊拉耶姆！天上好多火尾。星人又射火箭，然后大响……

source: Yira Ahoo – what clear shine! Like a creek-pool in the sun. Thank you Apa! I like it the most! Will keep it for all my days!
target: 伊拉啊呼，好清亮！像太阳下的溪潭。谢谢阿爸！最喜欢！一辈子留着！

source: Hrokk: Yours. Remember the sky-fire from the night before this day?

Hrokk: Yem, the earth-roar. The big-loud. I lead hunters and find a large ground-hole with a great, hot rock. Bigger hole than any made from family of ground sloths. All agree: it fell from the star-people. Rock was split open half-half, like fallen ground-squash. The rock-seed was this green crystal-rock.
target: 赫洛克：耶姆，大地吼，大响。我带猎人找，找到大地洞，里头大热石。比地懒一家挖的洞都大。都同意，星人那里落下。石裂两半，像摔地的瓜。石头种子，就是这绿晶石。

source: Apa left for hunt and not return until dusktime. Ama went to gather sparkleberries and flax. Uggh, flax means more rope-making with the old-wives tomorrow… Today no one need to know: I sneak and search in the aspen forest for more crystal-rock! Worry not needed, brought my bone knife. Maybe star-people will send more rocks to us? Hope so. Want a red one like cranberry. Also night-purple one like dewberry. I show Apa, Ama, and older children – all will name me tribe rockfinder and beg me to find— Ho! Pine needles snapping… Be still. Listen… That size… POISON BREATHER! RUN! RUN! *panting* Poison Breather *pant*… fast like deer… *panting* Fight then Poison Breather! Come! Look, look me cutting! Sharp crystal-rock from sky-people! Crystal rock with killing magic! What… What this line of lightning… not burn to touch… can go through…
target: 阿爸出猎，天昏才回。阿妈采闪亮莓和亚麻。唉，亚麻，明天又得跟老女人搓绳…… 今天不用让人知道：偷偷进白杨林，找更多晶石！不必怕，带了骨刀。 星人会再送石头？希望。想要蔓越莓般红，也要露莓般夜紫。给阿爸、阿妈、大孩子看，都叫我部落寻石人，求我找—— 嚯！松针断声…… 不动，听…… 那么大…… 吐毒者！跑！跑！ ＊喘＊ 吐毒者＊喘＊……快如鹿…… ＊喘＊ 那就打，吐毒者！来！看我划！星人来的尖晶石，有杀人魔法的晶石！ 什么……这闪电线……碰不烫……能穿过……

source: Tribe needs work faster. Hearts not beating to rhythm of the big-plan, eyes not set on the could-be. Big Bear in the stars shows it is time to seed, but first the plaza needs to seal the earth… It is certain: somewhere here is the way to the spirit world. The opening. We must close it to be safe. How else did Great Betrayer leave no tracks after he struck my skull? I tell to the family elders, I tell to the storykeepers, I tell to the learning-hunters and the women-of-the-fields… I tell all: Great Betrayer stepped through the earth and so we must seal the earth with clay brick. As many clay brick as stars in the sky and stones in the creek. So we may live on the safe, sealed floors of our huts beside the Cloudbreaker mountain, which already seals the earth it sits on. My command not harsh: every home must have floor of clay brick. Every much-used path must be of clay brick. And now we work to finish a great plaza of clay brick. An open space for play, ritual, gathering – all sealed with clay brick. No more lost daughters, no more betrayers. Wife tells me of the whispers. The medicine woman, the old hunters, and now my young-man son. All worry that Hrokk has mind-frenzy, that my vision fixes on something not in the human world but in the spirit world. Mmph. They are part-right. I cannot forget the Great Betrayer. Helped us grow more, eat more, fight less than ever before – but tricked me and took my memento-gem of Yira. I can never forget Yira.
target: 部落得做更快。心没跟大计划同拍，眼没看可能的未来。星中大熊说该播种，可先要广场封住地…… 确定，通灵界的路就在这里某处，那个开口。得关上才安全。不然，大背叛者打我头后，怎没脚印？我告诉家族长老、故事守护者、学徒猎人、田里女人……告诉所有人：大背叛者穿地，所以用泥砖封地。泥砖像星那么多，像溪石那么多。这样，才能住在破云山旁、安全封闭的屋地上。山已封住脚下的地。 命令不苛：每家泥砖地，每条常走路都铺泥砖。现在，完成大泥砖广场，游玩、仪式、聚会的空地，全封泥砖。不再失去女儿，不再有背叛者。 妻告诉我耳语。药女、老猎人，现在连年轻儿子，都怕赫洛克心智狂乱，目光固定在灵界，而非人界。 嗯，他们对一半。 忘不了大背叛者。帮我们长更多、吃更多、少争斗，却骗我，夺走纪念伊拉的宝石。 永远忘不了伊拉。
